hardwareHubs.note: The Arkansas Regional Innovation Hub runs Makerspace Studios with laser cutters and 3D printers.
The Arkansas Research and Technology Park hosts the GENESIS Technology Incubator and companies such as Wolfspeed.

makerspaces.name: Arkansas Regional Innovation Hub Makerspace Studios
makerspaces.note: Membership access to a wood shop, laser cutters, 3D printers and more after a staff assessment.

makerspaces.name: Fayetteville Public Library Koenig Family Fabrication and Robotics Lab
makerspaces.note: Public lab with 3D printers, a laser cutter and engraver, and a CNC router, after an orientation.

events.name: Maker Faire NWA
events.note: Held at the Fayetteville Public Library on September 7, 2024 and September 6, 2025.

programs.name: GENESIS Technology Incubator
programs.note: University of Arkansas incubator at the Research and Technology Park with engineering lab access and shared services.

specialties.name: Steel and metals
specialties.note: AEDC says metals employs over 22,000 people and Mississippi County has the second-largest steel production capacity in the nation.

specialties.name: Aerospace and defense
specialties.note: An AEDC booklet reports 220 aerospace and defense operations and that aerospace is the state's leading export.

specialties.name: Poultry and food processing
specialties.note: AEDC ranks Arkansas second nationally in broiler production and lists Tyson Foods among its manufacturers.

specialties.name: Wood products
specialties.note: AEDC says Arkansas is the second leading lumber producing state in the South.

support.name: Arkansas Manufacturing Solutions (AEDC)
support.note: Arkansas's NIST MEP center, with growth and innovation, operational excellence, cybersecurity and technology transfer grant help.
